problems.what:
The 153@328 walk is specified as a plain `trigger` (until z_gt 1200, no target), but a trigger cannot accept a field change. If route_to's own record already holds the next field, x_trigger goes left_for -> strayed -> V11 (driver), even though Steiner took the right door. The map's 'ready' rests on route_to returning at the first read with control gone; in the game it does not.

Why:
- After ExitField the engine keeps walking him toward the exit point until Field() halts the VM.
- The smooth walk settle()s after every hold until the published position stops moving, which is about when the map switches.
- So whether `landed` is None (done) or 154/31246 (V11) is a race. O2's archive puts it at about 1 run in 3.

Knock-ons:
- Two R-DOOR runs both pass about 44% of the time, so the race can slip past the freeze.
- rerun.max 2 can exhaust a side's coverage.
- Inherited VOID-ASYM (b) reads 'every run of one side VOID in one class' as a structural fork deviation. A driver race could then pose as a fork finding (question 7).
- FakeGame stops the player dead when a region fires, so the dry run can never show the race (a check that cannot fail).
